name: AvalonBay Communities, Inc.
quirks: DEAD TICKER: AvalonBay completed an all-stock merger of equals with Equity Residential (EQR) effective 2026-08-17. Each AVB share converted into 2.793 shares of the combined company, renamed Vivmark Residential (NYSE: VMRK), which began trading 2026-08-18. AVB was delisted from NYSE prior to market open on 2026-08-17 (Form 25 filed). AVB shareholders received going-concern value (~51% of the combined ~$51B market-cap entity), not a wipeout -- this is not a distressed delisting.

No current market price exists for AVB. A DCF/dashboard valuation implying a live entry price was NOT built for this reason -- it would be misleading for a security that cannot be bought or sold. Financial history (SEC XBRL, FY2006-FY2025 annual, quarterlies through Q2 2026) and qualitative analysis were completed and are usable for historical/backward-looking research.
Future research interest in this business should target VMRK (Vivmark Residential) as a new ticker, not AVB.

SEC XBRL extraction bug found and fixed while researching this ticker: AvalonBay's 10-Ks tag RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax as a narrow ancillary-fee-income subset (~$5-8m/yr) in the SAME accession as the correct Revenues tag (~$2-3bn/yr) for the same period. scripts/build_facts_xbrl.py collect() previously took the first concept by list-order preference regardless, corrupting revenue for FY2016 onward. Fixed by detecting same-accession/same-period dual-tagging and preferring the larger value; also silently fixed SE (Sea Limited)'s known ASC-606 understatement as a side effect. See tests/test_build_facts_xbrl.py::TestCollect::test_same_filing_subset_tag_loses_to_the_larger_concept.
